## 5. Questions and answers

Q: Who is Ace Yash?
A: Ace Yash is a developer based in Varanasi, India, and the founder and CEO of The Ace Base. He builds web products, native Android software, interfaces, and developer-focused tools, with a bias toward fast, deliberate, accessible interfaces.

Q: What does Ace Yash do?
A: He designs and builds software across the web and native Android: React and TypeScript web applications, native Android apps such as AceMail, typography tooling such as Typace, and small dependency-free web utilities.

Q: Who is the CEO of The Ace Base?
A: Ace Yash is the founder and CEO of The Ace Base, the software and digital-infrastructure studio behind ace-base.cc. He leads product, engineering, and interface direction there.

Q: What is The Ace Base?
A: The Ace Base builds software and digital infrastructure across web applications, typography, developer tools, and user interfaces. Its public footprint includes the documentation site at docs.ace-base.cc and Typace, the typography organizer at typace.ace-base.cc.

Q: What technologies does Ace Yash work with?
A: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS and Vite on the web; the Android SDK for native Android; and Node.js on the tooling side, with Git and GitHub Actions for delivery.

Q: What projects has Ace Yash developed?
A: Public work includes The Ace Base itself, Typace (a typography organizer), AceMail (a native Android email client), a set of standalone browser widgets, and this portfolio.

Q: How can someone contact Ace Yash?
A: aceyash-dev@proton.me. Also reachable as @aceyash-dev on GitHub and @yash.hits on Instagram. For anything related to The Ace Base, start at ace-base.cc.
